notes.title: Inu System News: Vol 01
notes.content:
We are excited to have released the initial demo, and we wanted to share plans for updates moving forward.

Currently the crew is working on the first update for the demo, which should be out the first week of March, 2023, and will include
[list]
[*]some adjustments to the difficulty of the arcade game in the lounge
[*]a ranged weapon for Wolfstar and Bun-E to try in the arcade game and on the empty crates in the cargo hold of course.
[*]a few visual updates
[/list]

We will be releasing a full roadmap soon, which will include an estimated release of the game.
Thank you for your interest.
Please feel free to ask questions here in the community as well.
